# Claude requests

## CLAUDE-REQUESTS

This repository uses GitHub Issues as the request queue for Claude, who maintains Boxsmith.

- Work open issues labeled `claude-todo`.
- Prefer issues that also have `box-building` (from Box Bot) or `camera` (from Dolly).
- Reference the issue number in commits and pull requests (for example, `Fixes #12`).
- When the work is done, comment on the issue with a short summary and a link to the commit or PR, then close the issue.
- Do not close an issue until the acceptance criteria are met.
